g.title: TS_Definition
g.text: Tensile strength = resistance of soil mass to being pulled apart

g.title: TS_Particulate
g.text: Soil is particulate → tensile capacity emerges from bonding, suction, cementation

g.title: TS_NonCohesive
g.text: Non-cohesive soils (sands, gravels) → negligible tensile strength unless suction/cemented

g.title: TS_LowVsComp
g.text: Tensile strength ≪ compressive strength (1–3 orders of magnitude lower)

g.title: TS_Engineering
g.text: Controls crack initiation, slope failure, desiccation fissures, dam cracking
Key Controls on Tensile Strength of Soil

g.title: TC_Density
g.text: Closer contacts, lower void ratio → ↑ strength

g.title: TC_Cementation
g.text: Carbonates, Fe-oxides, lime, cement → rigid bonds

g.title: SP_Comp_Par
g.text: Void ratio, stiffness E, OCR, stress path

g.title: SP_Tension_F
g.text: Desiccation cracks, tension cracks in slopes

g.title: SP_Tension_F->SP_Shear_F
g.text: Cracks create weak planes → shear failure

g.title: MC_Suction
g.text: Increase in matric suction ψ = u_a - u_w

g.title: MC_Propagation
g.text: Crack tips advance, suction drops in void

g.title: MC_Failure
g.text: Shear along crack planes, block detachment, slope instability
